intention: The design step in a ticket's workflow becomes a node with gated exits (intentions cleared, tickets reviewed) where back-to-design routes, making non-linearity structural rather than ad hoc.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver spent on the novel — re-deriving design is the defect), Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — each design crossing is measured with gate evidence)

falsifier.proves_red: A ticket routed back from /sorted goes through /design, both exit gates check (intentions cleared, tickets reviewed), re-enters BUILDME, and the two design-node crossings are visible in the ticket's history with distinct gate evidence. If the gates cannot be checked or the loop-back produces no evidence distinguishable from a first pass, the intent was wrong.

how: Charter update (skills/design/intention+why.json — add exit gate fields) + door.py update (skills/design/door.py — enforce the new fields on exit) + probe (skills/design/probes/design_exit_gates_fire.py).
